title: Undefeated Progella, Pagara outlast Japanese opponents to reach Asiad semis
summary: The Alas Pilipinas beach pair of Sofiah Pagara and Khy Progella has reached the semifinals of women's beach volleyball at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026.
